objective: Preallocate join predicate schema-membership column extraction sets from known schema sizes.

tasks.title: Preallocate join schema predicate column sets
tasks.result: Join predicate schema-membership helpers now preallocate temporary column sets from known schema bounds.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
Schema-pair predicate checks use a saturating sum of the two schema column counts.
Multi-schema predicate membership uses a saturating sum across participating schemas.
Single-schema membership uses schema.columns.len() as the capacity hint.
